purpose: Authoritative eligibility registry used to check cohort claims in candidate cards. It is not a biological knowledge base.

GSE120575.basis: Primary metadata were parsed from the GEO SOFT record; the frozen primary subset is pre-treatment anti-PD-1 monotherapy.

GSE91061.basis: Treatment time point and RECIST labels were parsed from GEO SOFT. Bulk RNA cannot replicate a cell-state association at single-cell measurement level.

GSE78220.basis: Read-only audit v1 matched all 28 XLSX matrix headers to GEO SOFT sample titles. It retained 27 pre-treatment pembrolizumab columns (15 objective responders, 12 non-objective responders) and excluded one on-treatment column. Bulk RNA cannot replicate a single-cell cell-state association; source-level participant dependence remains unresolved.

GSE115978.basis: The locally acquired public cell annotation lacks a frozen patient-level baseline ICI response endpoint for this project.

GSE72056.basis: Treatment-naive melanoma atlas; it does not supply a baseline ICI response comparison.

GSE174401.basis: The public study is an anatomic atlas of brain, leptomeningeal, and cutaneous metastases, not an audited baseline ICI response cohort.

HRA005837.basis: A neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 single-cell study, but data access is controlled and response metadata have not been independently audited.

GSE244983.basis: GEO metadata describe four samples: two ICB-resistant/progression samples and two ICB-naive samples. This is not an independently audited pre-treatment responder/non-responder cohort.

GSE273718.basis: Public GEO summary reports temporal profiling across anti-PD-1, anti-CTLA-4, and combination therapy; available sample-level clinical response and baseline eligibility require independent audit before any response-association use.

GSE211504.basis: Public GEO summary describes peripheral CD8 T cells from two melanoma patients receiving checkpoint blockade; sample size, compartment, and treatment heterogeneity preclude response-replication use.
